items.html:
Bernard Loots grew up in South Africa and moved to the Netherlands in 2006. He learnt his cricket playing club cricket for Durbanville in the Western Cape, and is a medium-paced seam bowler and aggressive lower-order batsman. A consistent performer at his club (HCC) in the Netherlands, Loots made a successful debut for Netherlands. Replacing the injured Maurits Jonkman in the squad, he picked up 3 for 16 against Ireland at the WCL Division One tournament in Netherlands in July 2010, taking his first two international wickets with his second and third balls in the game.
Liam Brickhill
